rubrics.scorer_requirement: Adult with functional French literacy; educator review preferred before decisions. Preserve the original response.

anchors.1: A few relevant words; requested message is mostly missing.
anchors.2: Main message is understandable; one requested element may be missing.
anchors.3: All requested elements are communicated clearly.

anchors.1: Very limited or frequently inappropriate vocabulary.
anchors.3: Appropriate range for the prompt, including useful detail.

anchors.1: Fragments or persistent word-order/verb problems obscure meaning.
anchors.2: Simple sentences mostly work; errors do not block the message.
anchors.3: Sentences are controlled and connected appropriately for the prompt.

anchors.2: Mostly readable; some errors in spelling, articles, accents, or punctuation.
anchors.3: Conventions are accurate enough that errors are minor.

anchors.0: Response was supplied or corrected by another person.
anchors.2: Only allowed interface support was used.

rubrics.calculation: Sum score*weight. Divide by maximum weighted score (30) and multiply by 100.

rubrics.scorer_requirement: Adult who can understand spoken French must listen to the original recording. Transcript-only scoring is prohibited; educator review preferred.

anchors.1: A few relevant words; requested message is mostly missing.
anchors.2: Main message is understandable; one requested element may be missing.
anchors.3: All requested elements are communicated clearly.

anchors.0: No French speech can be understood.
anchors.1: A patient listener understands isolated parts.
anchors.2: A patient listener understands the main message despite repetitions or errors.
anchors.3: The whole message is readily understandable to a patient listener.

anchors.1: Limited words or fragments; frequent form problems.
anchors.2: Familiar words and simple structures usually carry the message.
anchors.3: Appropriate range and structure for the prompt.

anchors.1: Long pauses prevent a connected message.
anchors.2: Some pauses or restarts, but the message continues.
anchors.3: Pacing supports the message for this task.

anchors.1: Sound patterns often make familiar words hard to recognize.
anchors.2: Most familiar words are recognizable; a few sound patterns need attention.
anchors.3: Sound patterns and rhythm consistently support understanding.

rubrics.calculation: Sum score*weight. Divide by maximum weighted score (30) and multiply by 100.

examples.audio_description: Name is clear; age phrase requires one replay; response is independent.
examples.comment: Main message is clear. One sound target can be chosen later for teaching.

examples.audio_description: Directions contain all map steps and are readily understood with natural pauses.
examples.comment: Complete, controlled response for the task.

examples.audio_description: Transcript captured several words, but the recording is too noisy to judge the child’s speech.
examples.comment: Preserve as invalid evidence; do not infer pronunciation from the transcript.

unresolved_review_handling: If no eligible human scorer is available, retain the response and report awaiting_review. Do not assign a band or substitute speech-to-text/AI-only scoring.
